Event dates and citations checked against the primary documents. The enactment event now cites the GovInfo public law page; the detail on the 30 sales stays attributed to BOEM's 2025-11-10 notice, which has its own event.

proposal: The Mandate recommends reinstating quarterly onshore lease sales in producing states, holding offshore sales to the maximum extent under the current program while developing a new five-year plan, and setting rents, royalties and bonding no higher than Inflation Reduction Act levels. It also recommends rescinding the Biden-era BLM waste prevention rule and working with Congress on leasing legislation.

status_summary: Public Law 119-21 (2025-07-04) restored a 12.5 percent minimum federal oil and gas royalty (BLM published a direct final rule on 2026-04-29, scheduled to take effect 2026-06-29 absent significant adverse comment; a correction followed on 2026-05-21 and no withdrawal notice was found) and requires at least 30 Gulf of America offshore lease sales through 2040; the first such sale opened bids on 2025-12-10 and the third (2026-08-12) drew about 82.7 million dollars in high bids on 59 blocks. BLM continues onshore sales, for example Wyoming and Colorado sales reported at 87.3 million dollars (press release 2026-09-10). Several Mandate items are not complete: BOEM has published only a draft proposed 11th National OCS Program (2025-11-24), and BLM extended phase-in dates for the 2024 waste prevention rule (2025-12-15 and 2026-04-30) rather than rescinding it. On 2026-06-24 BLM proposed rules on oil and gas leasing (including a return to earlier bond minimums) and on royalty for oil and gas lost from onshore leases; neither is final.

timeline.event: Public Law 119-21 is enacted (GovInfo dates it 2025-07-04); its section 50102 concerns offshore oil and gas leasing. BOEM's 2025-11-10 notice (next entry) describes it as requiring at least 30 Gulf of America lease sales through 2040 on the Lease Sale 254 terms with a 12.5 percent royalty.
BOEM publishes the final notice of sale for the first Gulf of America sale under the 2025 law (bids opened 2025-12-10; at least 80 million acres offered; 12.5 percent royalty).
BOEM publishes the draft proposed program, first analysis and proposal, for the 11th National OCS Oil and Gas Leasing Program (the first stage of a new five-year plan; later stages not found).
BLM publishes a rule extending phase-in requirements of its waste prevention, royalty and resource conservation rule (a second extension followed on 2026-04-30); the rule text was not reviewed.

BLM publishes a direct final rule setting a 12.5 percent minimum royalty for federal oil and gas leases issued after enactment, scheduled to take effect 2026-06-29 absent significant adverse comments.
BLM proposes to update its oil and gas leasing regulations to reflect recent legislation and executive orders and to restore earlier minimum bond amounts.
Interior reports the third Gulf of America sale under the 2025 law: $82.7 million in high bids on 59 blocks from 16 companies, about 80.4 million acres offered.
BLM reports Wyoming (99 parcels, 114,389 acres) and Colorado (29 parcels, 14,212 acres) onshore sales totaling $87.3 million.

title: Resume and expand federal onshore and offshore oil and gas leasing
